properties.query:
NetcraftSocialResult_Latest
| where IngestedAt > ago(15m)
| mv-apply Tag = Tags on (
    where tostring(Tag.category) == "input_required"
    | summarize InputRequiredTags = make_set(tostring(Tag.display_name))
  )
| where array_length(InputRequiredTags) > 0
| extend
    RiskCategory = tostring(Risk.category),
    InputRequiredTags = strcat_array(InputRequiredTags, ", ")
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    EventId,
    ResultUuid,
    Subject,
    Platform,
    SocialType,
    Username,
    DisplayName,
    Url,
    RiskCategory,
    InputRequiredTags,
    ChangeType,
    CloudEventType
properties.description:
Identifies Social results that are waiting for client input.
A result needs client input when any tag on the result (`data.tags`) has category `input_required`.
Uses NetcraftSocialResult_Latest so one ResultUuid alerts from the latest social result in the window.
properties.name: Netcraft Social - Pending client input

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Social result {{ResultUuid}} on {{Platform}} needs client input.
